# hacienda - Kotlin/Android Bindings

Bindings for hacienda

## Installation

Add the generated AAR to your Android module's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("com.github.jamon8888:hacienda-android:VERSION")
}
```

## Quick Start

```kotlin
import com.github.jamon8888.Hacienda

// The bundled native library is loaded via System.loadLibrary().
```

## Documentation

For full documentation, see the [hacienda repository](https://github.com/jamon8888/hacienda-engine).
